comment: fx_chorus, one line only. delaytime1 is in SAMPLES: 720 at 48 kHz is 15 ms, so render the Max side at 48 kHz or the two are different delays. delaytime2onOff = 0 keeps the prototype's second line out (we have no counterpart, and the render is refused if you switch it on). feedbackPolarity = 0 because the prototype's feedback coefficient is exactly +-1 and ours clamps at +-0.95. drywet is a DRY per cent.
